items.title: USN-8957-1: authd vulnerability
items.summary: Ali Mashally discovered that authd did not properly validate user identities when matching accounts from identity providers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to gain access to another user's local account and files, resulting in unauthorized access to sensitive information.

items.title: USN-8956-1: Brotli vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Brotli incorrectly handled certain compressed streams. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-8954-1: zlib vulnerability
items.summary: Ali Firas discovered that zlib incorrectly handled certain non-blocking write operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to trigger a heap buffer overflow, resulting in a denial of service or arbitrary code execution.

items.title: USN-8953-1: OpenVPN vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that OpenVPN incorrectly handled certificate subject fields. A remote authenticated user could possibly use this issue to impersonate other users.
